title: Jay Stratton’s FIRST-EVER Interview - Before The World Knew His Name
description:
Before Jay Stratton became a public face of the UFO disclosure movement, before his book Out of the Shadows, and before his revelations about non-human craft and beings made national headlines, George Knapp and Jeremy Corbell traveled to Huntsville, Alabama, in 2022 to record his very first on-camera interview.

Now, WEAPONIZED revisits that historic conversation with the former director of the Pentagon’s UAP Task Force - the man who helped shape AAWSAP, AATIP, and the government’s modern UFO investigations.

In never before seen footage, Stratton reveals how the Pentagon investigated the TIC TAC, GIMBAL, and GOFAST encounters, why he consulted engineers at Lockheed Martin’s Skunk Works and Boeing’s Phantom Works, and what happened when military UFO evidence reached his desk. He also confirms that the massive AAWSAP database became a foundation for subsequent government investigations.

Knapp and Corbell examine Stratton’s newly public claims about recovered non-human technology, his identification as the mysterious “Axelrod” from Skinwalkers at the Pentagon, and the alleged CIA intervention that prevented a transfer of UFO-related materials from Lockheed Martin to Robert Bigelow’s research program.
